metadata.title: Clicked like I’m throwing spaghetti and somehow landed a kill? Valorant’s aim is cheating again
metadata.description:
Me: flailing like I lost my mouse
Enemy: probably questioning their existence
Valorant just gifted me a kill out of pure chaos
Click if your aim ever surprises even YOU!

Tap if your panic aim ever does the impossible!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckykill #funnygaming #shorts
